title: Eob Cms1500
description: Eob Cms1500 contract normalized from the DocuBricks Healthcare library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Form
metadata:
  name: docubricks-healthcare-eob-cms1500
  title: Eob Cms1500
  description: Eob Cms1500 contract normalized from the DocuBricks Healthcare library.
  version: healthcare_eob_cms1500_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: healthcare/eob_cms1500
    sourcePath: Schemas/healthcare/eob_cms1500
    sourceVersion: healthcare_eob_cms1500_v1
    sourceDigest: fb071356d645b075f92c3c4345ece8fcfbf2501b4947218e2b9e1779b43bd055
spec:
  role: completion
  pages:
    - id: main
      title: Eob Cms1500
      sections:
        - id: dates-and-terms
          title: Dates And Terms
          description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: rendering-provider-npi
              name: rendering_provider_npi
              label: Rendering Provider Npi
              description: NPI of the actual rendering/treating provider if different from billing provider
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: date-of-service-from
              name: date_of_service_from
              label: Date Of Service From
              description: Start date of service, format YYYY-MM-DD (CMS-1500 Box 24A From)
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: date-of-service-to
              name: date_of_service_to
              label: Date Of Service To
              description: End date of service, format YYYY-MM-DD (CMS-1500 Box 24A To); same as from if single-day service
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: document-details
          title: Document Details
          description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: claim-number
              name: claim_number
              label: Claim Number
              description: Unique claim identifier assigned by payer (X12 835 CLM01 or payer-assigned reference number)
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: patient-dob
              name: patient_dob
              label: Patient Dob
              description: Patient date of birth, format YYYY-MM-DD
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: patient-member-id
              name: patient_member_id
              label: Patient Member Id
              description: Health plan member/subscriber ID number
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: provider-npi
              name: provider_npi
              label: Provider Npi
              description: National Provider Identifier (NPI) of billing provider — 10-digit numeric
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: payer-id
              name: payer_id
              label: Payer Id
              description: Payer's electronic ID or NAIC code
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: group-number
              name: group_number
              label: Group Number
              description: Patient's insurance group number
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: procedure-codes
              name: procedure_codes
              label: Procedure Codes
              description: Array of CPT/HCPCS procedure codes billed (e.g., ["99213", "93000"]). Each entry is a string.
                Include modifiers as suffix if present (e.g., "99213-25")
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              span: 2
            - id: diagnosis-codes
              name: diagnosis_codes
              label: Diagnosis Codes
              description: Array of ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes (e.g., ["I10", "E11.9"]). Extract all listed diagnosis
                pointers
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              span: 2
            - id: patient-responsibility
              name: patient_responsibility
              label: Patient Responsibility
              description: Total amount patient owes (copay + coinsurance + deductible) as decimal
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: denial-reason-code
              name: denial_reason_code
              label: Denial Reason Code
              description: ANSI X12 835 Group/Claim Adjustment Reason Code (CARC) if denied or adjusted (e.g., "96", "CO-4",
                "PR-1"). Null if claim was fully paid
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: remark-codes
              name: remark_codes
              label: Remark Codes
              description: Array of Remittance Advice Remark Codes (RARC) associated with the claim (e.g., ["N130",
                "MA01"]). Null or empty array if none
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              span: 2
            - id: service-facility-npi
              name: service_facility_npi
              label: Service Facility Npi
              description: NPI of the service facility (CMS-1500 Box 32b)
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: financials
          title: Financials
          description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: billed-amount
              name: billed_amount
              label: Billed Amount
              description: Total amount billed/charged by provider as decimal (CMS-1500 Box 28 or EOB "Billed" column total)
              dataType: number
              widget: number
              required: true
            - id: allowed-amount
              name: allowed_amount
              label: Allowed Amount
              description: Payer-allowed/contracted amount as decimal (EOB "Allowed" or "Eligible" amount)
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: paid-amount
              name: paid_amount
              label: Paid Amount
              description: Amount actually paid by payer to provider as decimal (X12 835 BPR02 or EOB "Plan Paid" amount)
              dataType: number
              widget: number
        - id: parties
          title: Parties
          description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: patient-name
              name: patient_name
              label: Patient Name
              description: Full name of the patient (Last, First Middle or First Last format)
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: provider-name
              name: provider_name
              label: Provider Name
              description: Name of the billing/rendering provider or group practice
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: payer-name
              name: payer_name
              label: Payer Name
              description: Name of the insurance company or health plan paying the claim
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: service-facility-name
              name: service_facility_name
              label: Service Facility Name
              description: Name of the facility where services were rendered (if different from billing provider)
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: risk-and-compliance
          title: Risk And Compliance
          description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: claim-status
              name: claim_status
              label: Claim Status
              description: "Adjudication outcome. One of: Paid | Denied | Pending | Adjusted"
              dataType: string
              widget: text
  validationRules:
    - id: claim-number-not-null
      severity: error
      description: Claim number is the primary key for downstream remittance reconciliation and HIPAA 835
        transaction matching — no valid EOB record without it
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: claim_number
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: claim_number
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: claim_number IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(claim_number)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: avg-confidence-minimum
      severity: warning
      description: Overall extraction confidence below 0.65 indicates document quality or format issues too severe
        for reliable automated processing — route to human review queue
      rule:
        op: gte
        left:
          field: avg_confidence
        right:
          value: 0.65
      sourceExpression: avg_confidence >= 0.65
      supported: true
    - id: claim-status-valid-enum
      severity: warning
      description: Claim status must be a recognized adjudication outcome; invalid values break downstream
        remittance posting workflows and denial management routing
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: claim_status
            right:
              value: Paid
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: claim_status
            right:
              value: Denied
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: claim_status
            right:
              value: Pending
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: claim_status
            right:
              value: Adjusted
      sourceExpression: claim_status IN ('Paid', 'Denied', 'Pending', 'Adjusted')
      supported: true
    - id: billed-amount-positive
      severity: warning
      description: Billed amount must be present and positive — zero or null indicates claim header extraction
        failure; cannot reconcile remittance without charge amount
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: billed_amount
          - op: gt
            left:
              field: billed_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: billed_amount IS NOT NULL AND billed_amount > 0
      supported: true
    - id: patient-member-id-present
      severity: warning
      description: Member ID is required for eligibility verification and patient account matching; missing value
        prevents automated posting — flag for manual resolution
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: patient_member_id
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: patient_member_id
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: patient_member_id IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(patient_member_id)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: paid-amount-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: Paid amount cannot be negative; negative value indicates extraction error or overpayment recovery
        scenario requiring manual review
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: paid_amount
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: paid_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: paid_amount IS NULL OR paid_amount >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: denial-reason-required-for-denied
      severity: warning
      description: Denied claims must have a CARC denial reason code for appeals processing and denial management
        reporting; missing code flags extraction gap
      rule:
        op: not
        rule:
          op: and
          rules:
            - op: eq
              left:
                field: claim_status
              right:
                value: Denied
            - op: not
              rule:
                op: present
                field: denial_reason_code
      sourceExpression: NOT (claim_status = 'Denied' AND denial_reason_code IS NULL)
      supported: true
    - id: provider-npi-format
      severity: warning
      description: NPI must be exactly 10 numeric digits per HIPAA standard; format violation indicates extraction
        confusion with Tax ID or other identifiers
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: provider_npi
          - op: and
            rules:
              - op: eq
                left:
                  length: provider_npi
                right:
                  value: 10
              - op: matches
                left:
                  field: provider_npi
                pattern: ^[0-9]{10}$
      sourceExpression: provider_npi IS NULL OR (LENGTH(provider_npi) = 10 AND provider_npi REGEXP '^[0-9]{10}$')
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      claim_number:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Claim number is the HIPAA 835 transaction key — required for remittance reconciliation, ERA
          posting, and CMS audit trail; extraction errors break end-to-end payment workflow
      patient_member_id:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Member ID links claim to eligibility and patient account; errors cause misposting, HIPAA EDI
          rejection, and patient billing failures
      provider_npi:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: NPI is HIPAA-mandated provider identifier for claims submission and remittance; incorrect NPI
          causes ERA routing failures and CMS compliance issues
      rendering_provider_npi:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Rendering NPI required for split-billing and group practice remittance routing under HIPAA 5010;
          errors affect provider payment splits
      billed_amount:
        minConfidence: 0.95
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Billed amount is the financial anchor for all remittance calculations — contractual adjustments,
          patient responsibility, and payer payment are all derived from this value; must be highly accurate
      paid_amount:
        minConfidence: 0.93
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Paid amount drives cash posting to provider accounts receivable; extraction errors cause AR balance
          mismatches and potential fraud flag triggers
      allowed_amount:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Allowed amount validates contractual adjustment calculations and payer fee schedule compliance;
          important for revenue cycle analytics
      patient_responsibility:
        minConfidence: 0.88
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Patient responsibility amount drives patient billing statements; errors cause patient disputes and
          No Surprises Act compliance exposure
      claim_status:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Claim status determines downstream workflow routing — paid claims to cash posting, denied to denial
          management, pending to follow-up queue; misclassification has significant operational impact
      denial_reason_code:
        minConfidence: 0.8
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: CARC denial reason code is required for automated appeals and denial trend reporting; lower
          threshold acceptable as codes may be in stamps or footnotes
      procedure_codes:
        minConfidence: 0.88
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: CPT/HCPCS codes link to fee schedule pricing, utilization management, and clinical analytics;
          incomplete extraction understates procedure mix reporting
      diagnosis_codes:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: ICD-10 diagnosis codes support medical necessity validation and quality measure attribution;
          required for value-based care program reporting
      date_of_service_from:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Date of service is required for timely filing compliance tracking and coordination of benefits
          sequencing; errors cause COB and timely filing rule violations
      payer_name:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: false
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Payer name identifies the remitting entity for cash posting routing; lower threshold acceptable as
          payer may be identified by logo or ID rather than spelled-out name
      service_facility_npi:
        minConfidence: 0.88
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Service facility NPI required for place-of-service-based reimbursement rules and quality reporting
          attribution; errors affect site-of-care analytics
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-gemini-flash
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-dbrx-instruct
    maxTokens: 4096
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: EOB and CMS-1500 documents are visually complex — they contain dense multi-column service line
      tables, payer rubber stamps, checkboxes, hand-annotated remark codes, and mixed printed/handwritten
      content. Gemini Flash's multimodal capabilities enable direct image-based extraction from scanned EOBs
      and CMS-1500 paper forms, handling rotated text, stamps, and table structures that pure text models
      struggle with. The financial accuracy requirements (billed, allowed, paid amounts) and regulatory
      identifier precision (NPI, member ID) demand a model with strong visual grounding. DBRX Instruct serves
      as a cost-effective fallback for digitally-native EOB text extracts (e.g., payer portal exports,
      ERA-to-text conversions) where visual parsing is not needed.
  submissionSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      claim_number:
        type: string
        description: Unique claim identifier assigned by payer (X12 835 CLM01 or payer-assigned reference number)
      patient_name:
        type: string
        description: Full name of the patient (Last, First Middle or First Last format)
      patient_dob:
        type: string
        description: Patient date of birth, format YYYY-MM-DD
      patient_member_id:
        type: string
        description: Health plan member/subscriber ID number
      provider_name:
        type: string
        description: Name of the billing/rendering provider or group practice
      provider_npi:
        type: string
        description: National Provider Identifier (NPI) of billing provider — 10-digit numeric
      rendering_provider_npi:
        type: string
        description: NPI of the actual rendering/treating provider if different from billing provider
      payer_name:
        type: string
        description: Name of the insurance company or health plan paying the claim
      payer_id:
        type: string
        description: Payer's electronic ID or NAIC code
      group_number:
        type: string
        description: Patient's insurance group number
      date_of_service_from:
        type: string
        description: Start date of service, format YYYY-MM-DD (CMS-1500 Box 24A From)
      date_of_service_to:
        type: string
        description: End date of service, format YYYY-MM-DD (CMS-1500 Box 24A To); same as from if single-day service
      procedure_codes:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Array of CPT/HCPCS procedure codes billed (e.g., ["99213", "93000"]). Each entry is a string.
          Include modifiers as suffix if present (e.g., "99213-25")
      diagnosis_codes:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Array of ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes (e.g., ["I10", "E11.9"]). Extract all listed diagnosis pointers
      billed_amount:
        type: number
        description: Total amount billed/charged by provider as decimal (CMS-1500 Box 28 or EOB "Billed" column total)
      allowed_amount:
        type: number
        description: Payer-allowed/contracted amount as decimal (EOB "Allowed" or "Eligible" amount)
      paid_amount:
        type: number
        description: Amount actually paid by payer to provider as decimal (X12 835 BPR02 or EOB "Plan Paid" amount)
      patient_responsibility:
        type: string
        description: Total amount patient owes (copay + coinsurance + deductible) as decimal
      claim_status:
        type: string
        description: "Adjudication outcome. One of: Paid | Denied | Pending | Adjusted"
      denial_reason_code:
        type: string
        description: ANSI X12 835 Group/Claim Adjustment Reason Code (CARC) if denied or adjusted (e.g., "96", "CO-4",
          "PR-1"). Null if claim was fully paid
      remark_codes:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Array of Remittance Advice Remark Codes (RARC) associated with the claim (e.g., ["N130",
          "MA01"]). Null or empty array if none
      service_facility_name:
        type: string
        description: Name of the facility where services were rendered (if different from billing provider)
      service_facility_npi:
        type: string
        description: NPI of the service facility (CMS-1500 Box 32b)
    required:
      - claim_number
      - billed_amount
    additionalProperties: false
    x-ladder-docubricks:
      completenessChecklist:
        - id: required_fields_present
          description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
          fields:
            - claim_number
            - billed_amount
        - id: section_coverage_reviewed
          description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
          sections:
            - dates_and_terms
            - document_details
            - financials
            - parties
            - risk_and_compliance
        - id: nested_lists_normalized
          description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
          fields: []
